rationale.conceptual: The method is standard spin‑polarized DFT+U with prescribed Hubbard parameters, but the correct configuration of the metastable charge‑ordered state (antiferromagnetic ordering, specific supercell, and extraction of four distortion mode amplitudes from relaxed geometries) requires careful implementation and domain understanding. It is a non‑trivial but well‑documented multi‑part algorithm.
rationale.execution: The workflow comprises eight declared steps: building two crystal models, running two DFT+U geometry optimizations (with specified force convergence and k‑point meshes), and post‑processing results into four scored artifacts. Orchestrating a slab calculation, handling DFT software setup (Quantum ESPRESSO) and pseudopotentials, and managing intermediate I/O make this a multi‑stage pipeline with several load‑bearing handoffs.
